en:000000322.usage_en: Neutral term for the same passenger road vehicle as car; excludes train-car meanings.
en:000000322.context_en: Talking about a privately owned passenger road vehicle.

examples.text: The family bought a small automobile for local trips.

translations.pt-BR: A família comprou um carro pequeno para viagens locais.

en:000003126.usage_en: Full term for fridge; normal US usage, more formal than fridge in some other varieties.
en:000003126.context_en: Naming the household appliance that keeps food cold.

examples.text: The refrigerator is beside the kitchen door.

translations.pt-BR: A geladeira fica ao lado da porta da cozinha.

en:000003221.usage_en: Standard farewell; bye is the more casual short form. This is the farewell expression, not a noun or a final separation.
en:000003221.context_en: Saying farewell when someone is leaving.

examples.text: Goodbye, Ana. Have a safe trip home.

translations.pt-BR: Tchau, Ana. Faça uma boa viagem de volta para casa.

en:000003422.usage_en: Neutral relationship term; grandpa is more familiar. Direct address as Grandfather can sound formal or old-fashioned.
en:000003422.context_en: Referring to the father of one's mother or father.

examples.text: My grandfather lives near the park.

translations.pt-BR: Meu avô mora perto do parque.

en:000003423.usage_en: Neutral relationship term; grandma is more familiar. Direct address as Grandmother can sound formal or old-fashioned.
en:000003423.context_en: Referring to the mother of one's mother or father.

translations.pt-BR: A avó dela visita aos domingos.

en:000003994.usage_en: Usual UK wording for the device called a cell phone in US English; does not require a smartphone.
en:000003994.context_en: A portable telephone connected through a cellular network.

examples.text: Please turn your mobile phone off during the performance.

translations.pt-BR: Por favor, desligue seu celular durante a apresentação.
